title: Bubblegum Princess Warrior
description: A young female character with pink hair in a high ponytail stands in a dynamic pose against a solid lime green background. She wears a dark armored outfit with lime green accents, a small crown, black gloves, and boots, while blowing a pink bubblegum bubble and surrounded by floating green bubbles.
prompt: A confident young girl with bright pink hair tied in a high bubbly ponytail, wearing a small crown and a dark armored dress with lime green trim and bubble patterns. She is blowing a pink bubblegum bubble, one hand raised in a stop gesture, wearing black gloves and heavy boots. Green slime bubbles float around her. Dynamic stance, cartoon style, solid bright green background, clean vector art look.
